rows.question: Get acronyms of projects beginning in 2018
rows.pred_sql:
SELECT acronym
FROM (
  SELECT
    p.unics_id,
    COALESCE(pc4.acronym, p.acronym) AS acronym,
    COALESCE(pc4.start_date, p.start_date, pat.start_date) AS start_date
  FROM projects p
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
      unics_id,
      acronym,
      start_date
    FROM projects
  ) pc4 USING (unics_id)
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
      unics_id,
      acronym,
      start_date
    FROM projects
  ) pat USING (unics_id)
) t
WHERE start_date >= DATE '2018-01-01'
  AND start_date <= DATE '2018-12-31'
  AND acronym IS NOT NULL

rows.question: Find institutions from the region of Nordjylland
rows.pred_sql:
WITH eu_territorial_units_lookup AS (
SELECT
  geocode_regions,
  description,
  geocode_level,
  nuts_version
FROM
  eu_territorial_units
)
SELECT
  i.unics_id,
  i.institutions_name,
  i.acronym,
  i.short_name,
  i.country_id,
  i.geocode_regions_3,
  i.website,
  i.grid_id,
  i.db_pedia_url,
  i.wikidata_url
FROM institutions i
WHERE
  i.geocode_regions_3 = 'Nordjylland'
  OR i.geocode_regions_3 IN (
    SELECT geocode_regions
    FROM eu_territorial_units_lookup
    WHERE description = 'Nordjylland'
  )
ORDER BY i.institutions_name ASC

rows.question: Show the name of institutions based in Nordjylland
rows.pred_sql:
WITH eu_territorial_units_lookup AS (
  SELECT
    geocode_regions,
    description,
    geocode_level,
    nuts_version
  FROM eu_territorial_units
)
SELECT DISTINCT institutions.unics_id, institutions.institutions_name
FROM institutions
LEFT JOIN eu_territorial_units_lookup
  ON institutions.geocode_regions_3 = eu_territorial_units_lookup.geocode_regions
WHERE institutions.institutions_name IS NOT NULL
  AND (
    institutions.geocode_regions_3 ILIKE '%nordjylland%'
    OR eu_territorial_units_lookup.description ILIKE '%nordjylland%'
  )
ORDER BY institutions.institutions_name

rows.question: Show the name of members in projects costing less than the average project cost.

  pm.member_name
FROM
  project_members pm
JOIN
  projects p
  ON pm.project = p.unics_id
WHERE
  pm.member_name IS NOT NULL
  AND p.total_cost IS NOT NULL
  AND p.total_cost < (
    SELECT AVG(total_cost) FROM projects WHERE total_cost IS NOT NULL
  )
ORDER BY
  pm.member_name

rows.question: Find the id of projects with at least 100 members
rows.pred_sql:
SELECT pr.unics_id
FROM (
  SELECT
    pm.project AS project,
    COUNT(pm.unics_id) AS member_count
  FROM project_members pm
  GROUP BY pm.project
) mc
JOIN (
  SELECT
    p.unics_id,
    p.acronym,
    p.title,
    p.start_date,
    p.end_date,
    p.start_year,
    p.end_year,
    p.ec_fund_scheme,
    p.framework_program
  FROM projects p
) pr
  ON pr.unics_id = mc.project
WHERE mc.member_count >= 100

rows.question: Find the code and title of the funding scheme which funded the highest number of projects.
rows.pred_sql:
SELECT
  fs.code,
  fs.title,
  COUNT(DISTINCT p.unics_id) AS project_count
FROM projects p
JOIN funding_schemes fs
  ON p.ec_fund_scheme = fs.code
WHERE p.ec_fund_scheme IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY fs.code, fs.title
ORDER BY project_count DESC
LIMIT 1

rows.question: Find the projects which lasted the longest and have an end year and a start year
rows.pred_sql:
WITH projects_filtered AS (
  SELECT
    p.unics_id,
    p.acronym,
    p.title,
    p.start_year,
    p.end_year,
    (p.end_year - p.start_year) AS duration_years
  FROM projects p
  WHERE p.start_year IS NOT NULL
    AND p.end_year IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  unics_id,
  acronym,
  title,
  start_year,
  end_year,
  duration_years
FROM projects_filtered
WHERE duration_years = (SELECT MAX(duration_years) FROM projects_filtered)
ORDER BY duration_years DESC
